short.text: Tyson Alualu was a rotating defensive tackle behind starters Roy Miller and Sen'Derrick Marks in 2013, active for all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games and both playoff games. He could handle several alignments across the front and supply useful power, and he finished when the play came to him, with {{2013.regular.sacks:words}} sacks and {{2013.regular.tackles_for_loss:words}} tackles for loss in the regular season. His positional flexibility stood out more than any defining pass-rush counter or disruptive specialty.

transactions.text: Signed a five-year rookie contract with Jacksonville
Traded by Jacksonville to Houston for Houston's 2015 fourth-round pick
